prompt: A nightly partner feed adds an unexpected nested field and changes one timestamp from ISO-8601 to epoch milliseconds for 3% of rows. The current pipeline coerces both silently, producing null event times downstream. Add bounded schema evolution and quarantine behavior: preserve valid rows, isolate malformed/incompatible rows with reason codes, keep raw provenance, make reruns idempotent, and verify recovery after a parser update. Do not define business metrics.

requirements: versioned feed samples with known valid, new-compatible, and incompatible timestamp rows
raw landing area plus normalized sink and quarantine/dead-letter destination
rerun fixture demonstrating duplicate file delivery
reprocessing path that moves corrected quarantined rows exactly once
paired same-model skill/no-skill execution from the identical starting snapshot

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual data-pipeline-engineering boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=data-analysis; near-neighbor=data-visualization), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Define source authority, event/record identity, watermark, partition, schema, transformation lineage, retry semantics, and destination guarantees.
Schema drift is either explicitly accepted by versioned normalization or quarantined with provenance; silent coercion cannot convert invalid input into apparently valid downstream state.
Test reruns, partial batches, late/out-of-order data, schema additions/removals, malformed records, backfills, reconciliation totals, and lineage from output rows to source inputs.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not use processing time when event time matters, assume exactly-once from retries alone, discard bad rows without accounting, or let a backfill bypass normal quality gates.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (data-pipeline-engineering decision and boundary evidence; Representative verification results or explicit unavailable checks; Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale; Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
